description: LBLRTM is given tellurix's own layers -- pressure, temperature and molecular column of each, as IATM=0 layer input (``LBLRTMRunConfig.user_layers``) -- so the comparison measures physics, not two different atmospheres. The layer pressure is the air-weighted mean of the edges for both codes, lines and continua alike. Reports the transmission error at R=45,000 before and after fitting the H2O and CO2 column scales and a linear continuum, the way any fit would, and the per-species line and continuum ratios behind it. Writes ``docs/lblrtm_identical_layers.json``.
layer_pressure: air-weighted mean of the edges, both codes
tellurix: AER 3.9 lines within 25 cm-1, direct_sparse with pressure shifts; native MT_CKD 4.3
metric: absolute transmission error where the reference exceeds 0.05
